definitions.explanation: A state of disagreement or conflict between people, especially within a family, couple, or organization. Composed of 不 (not) + 和 (harmony). Implies an ongoing state of tension rather than a single argument.

examples.japanese: {夫婦|ふうふ}の{不和|ふわ}が{続|つづ}いている。
{家族|かぞく}の{不和|ふわ}が{原因|げんいん}で{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: I moved because of family discord.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}の{不和|ふわ}を{解消|かいしょう}するために、{話|はな}し{合|あ}いの{場|ば}を{設|もう}けた。
examples.english: We set up a forum for discussion to resolve the internal discord.

notes:
USAGE:
{不和|ふわ} describes a sustained state of conflict or lack of harmony between people. It is more formal and serious than {仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い (to be on bad terms), which is more conversational.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夫婦|ふうふ}{不和|ふわ} (marital discord)
- {家庭|かてい}{不和|ふわ} (family discord)
- {不和|ふわ}が{生|しょう}じる (discord arises)
- {不和|ふわ}を{招|まね}く (to invite discord)
- {不和|ふわ}を{解消|かいしょう}する (to resolve discord)
